CVE-2026-105031.title: When using the OpenSSL TLS implementation, both the pn_ssl_domain ...
CVE-2026-105031.description:
When using the OpenSSL TLS implementation, both the pn_ssl_domain_set_trusted_ca_db() & pn_tls_config_set_trusted_certs() APIs added to rather than replaced the default system trust anchors. Leading to potentially trusting unexpected peer certificates.



This can be worked around by setting the SSL_CERT_FILE environment variable for the application to /dev/null.



This issue does not affect the Win32 SChannel TLS implementation.



This issue affects Apache Qpid Proton C: through 0.40.0.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 0.41.1, which fixes the issue.

CVE-2026-105042.title: A message body that is deeply nested and decoded by pn_message_bo ...
CVE-2026-105042.description:
A message body that is deeply nested and decoded by pn_message_body() could overflow the stack and cause a crash.



This issue affects Apache Qpid Proton C: through 0.40.0.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 0.41.1, which fixes the issue.

CVE-2026-114230.title: When dispatching SASL frames to authenticate the peer, Proton wil ...
CVE-2026-114230.description:
When dispatching SASL frames to authenticate the peer, Proton will also dispatch AMQP frames if they claim to be SASL frames. This allows authentication bypass. However there will be no user name set so the effects depend on how the application deals with this condition - which otherwise means that authentication has not completed yet.



This issue affects Apache Qpid Proton C: through 0.40.0.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 0.41.1, which fixes the issue.

CVE-2026-115942.title: A misconfigured wildcard TLS certificate causes a stack read over ...
CVE-2026-115942.description:
A misconfigured wildcard TLS certificate causes a stack read overflow.



This issue does not affect any wildcard certificate issued to the RFC9525 standard - the fix only accepts certificates that comply to this standard.



This issue affects Apache Qpid Proton C: through 0.40.0.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 0.41.1, which fixes the issue.
